title: THE BASSET NINJA IS OUT!!!
text:
After months of waiting, this dear book is out!

 What would you do with a wily, rambunctious dog who gets into everything?

 This book takes you through a day in the life of a basset hound whose only goal in life is to get into as much trouble as possible!

 She is very food oriented and looks for every opportunity to sneak food away from its owner.

title: Just the beginning!
text:
Now that the Goblins have surrendered, they are all very sad, because they will just go back to their caves and be lonely. All they want are friends.

 Princess Rosebud takes pity on them. Since they want to be a part of Knochtwood Forest, she has the Pixies turn them into Gobligooks. Now they are no longer scary. They are Wood Faeries and help protect the forest.

 Now everyone can go home and live in peace, with the Golden Berry at its rightful place, Knochtwood Forest.

title: We Surrender!
text:
The Pixies are the last to show what they’ve got!

 They throw pixie dust on the Goblins and it shows what they are most afraid of! “Loneliness!”

 The Troll under the Bridge drops the Golden Berry, and the battle is over.

title: Who else has come to the Battle?
text:
The Popkins and the Faerie Army have also come to fight to get back the Golden Berry.

 The Faeries throw large, prickly pinecones at the Goblins! OUCH!!!

 The Popkins throw enchanted water to hurt the Goblins, by burning them.

 Who would you want to be? A Popkin or a Faerie Warrior?

title: The Battle Begins!
text:
The battle to win back the Golden Berry has begun.

 The Dwarfkins use catapults to throw red, hot acorns at the Goblins.

 The Munchkins use their robins to land on the Goblins’ heads to peck and scratch at them.

 Who would you want to be? A Dwarfkin or a Munchkin?

title: What would you ride continued!
text:
Princess Rosebud and Sir Fluffkins have more friends ready to help.

 The Popkins ride big, fuzzy bumblebees that dart in and out of danger, helping the Army to stay together and keep up morale.

 The Pixies twist and twirl on fluffy, fat dandelions, keeping watch over the Army and waiting until it is time to fight the Goblins.

title: What would you ride?
text:
Princess Rosebud and Sir Fluffkins are at the head of the Army and their friends are meeting them, ready to go.

 The Dwarfkins are riding their faithful prickly hedgehogs. They have treebark saddles, to make sure that they don’t get prickled.

 The Munchkins take to the air on robins. They soar in the sky watching and waiting, for when they are needed.

title: The Troll Under the Bridge
text:
The Goblins have stolen the Golden Berry and are using the Troll under the Bridge to carry it into battle. The problem is the Troll doesn’t want to.

 He is an innocent bystander and just wants to have peace and live under his bridge. So when the time comes, what will he do?

title: Meet the Goblins
text:
The Goblins have done something very foolish. They have stolen the Golden Berry.

 That means they have:

 Princess Rosebud coming after them

 Sir Fluffkins charging towards them

 The Dwarfkins, Munchkins, Popkins, and Pixies joining the fight

 A Faerie Army mounted on corgi steeds coming up behind

 There may have been some flaws in stealing the Golden Berry!

title: The Faerie Army
text:
Sir Fluffkins and Princess Rosebud are at the head of the battle to get back the Golden Berry from the Goblins, but the fight is not theirs alone.

 The faerie army rides forth on their corgi steeds to help battle the Goblins and reclaim the Golden Berry. Together with the Dwarkins, Munchkins, Popkins, and the Pixies, they march, fly, and ride to fight to save Knochtwood Forest and fight for what is right.

title: Meet the Dwarfkins
text:
The Dwarfkins are a part of the other Woodland Creatures. Like the Popkins, the Munchkins, and the Pixies, they will help bring the Golden Berry home to Knochtwood Forest.

 Sir Fluffkins and Princess Rosebud can’t do it by themselves. Who will they rely on to help them? Why the other woodland creatures! They need everyone’s help! No one gets left out!

 Who would you like to be? A Dwarfkin, a Popkin, a Munchkin, a Pixie, a Faerie Knight riding a Corgi Steed, Princess Rosebud, or will you ride Sir Fluffkins into battle?

title: Meet some of the Woodland Creatures
text:
Sir Fluffkins and Princess Rosebud and the Faerie Army need help getting the Golden Berry back, but they can’t do it all by themselves. They need the help of all their friends.

 Some of their friends include the the Popkins, the Munchkins, and the Pixies. Next time, we will bring in the Dwarfkins! Together, they will get back the Golden Berry from the Goblins, but how will they do it?

 First off, they need to work together! No one person is the hero. They must all do what they do best! Each creature is no better than anyone else!

 How have you been able to work through a problem? Do you have a friend or many friends that have solved something that you weren’t sure you wouldn’t be able to?

 Nothing is too big or too hard that you can’t work it through, especially if you have your parents, grandparents, other family members, or friends!

title: The Beautiful Princess Rosebud
text:
What if you were a princess in charge of a whole kingdom? What if everything depended on you to protect it? Princess Rosebud is in charge of the Golden Berry, a treasure that makes everything good and right in the Forest of Knochtwood and for all the creatures in the kindom.

 With courage, heart, and her faithful corgi steed, Sir Fluffkins, Princess Rosebud sets out to recover the Golden Berry, and restore peace to Knochtwood Forest.

 Because sometimes a princess doesn’t wait to be rescued. Sometimes she rides into the adventure herself!

title: Meet Sir Fluffkins
text:
He may be small. He may be fluffy, but he is not your ordinary, legendary knight! Sir Fluffkins is an unlikely hero in “Sir Fluffkins:Search for the Golden Berry!”

 Knights of old didn’t always ride horses. In Welsh folklore, Faeries of old would ride corgi steeds into battle. Sir Fluffkins is such a knight. His rider is the beautiful Princess Rosebud. She is the Princess over Knochtwood Forest and watches over the forest and its inhabitants. Together, they protect Knochtwood forest with the Golden Berry, which makes everything good and right.

title: Coming Soon! Basset Ninja!
text:
A sweet look into the day in the life of a Basset hound and the antics that this basset hound gets into!

 Our dog, Athena, was the prose behind this book! She is a lovable, if rambunctious, basset hound. We never knew that the floppy eared, big pawed, puppy would turn into a whirlwind on steroids.

 She loves to do everything the Basset Ninja loves to do, including getting pizzas(she’s done this), counter surfs(all the time), gets into the garbage(jumped right into the swaying top after she figured out how it worked), and waits until we are not looking and grabs the food and runs.

 More to come on this lovable story. I hope you will join us for the September 20th release of this fun story. There will be a workbook out soon after the release.

 Join me with my other books, “Floopa Loopa” and “Sir Fluffkins:Search for the Golden Berry” as I release the workbooks on PDF, on this website, and on Amazon. They will be just as much fun to work through as reading my books will be to read.

 Also, join me as I re-release my friend, Faith Dora Gudgell’s book, “How do Butterflies earn their Wings?”, a beautiful story dedicated to her friend, Vanessa, who passed away.

 It will be re-released sometime in October.

 See ya soon.

title: Floopa Loopa meets Elvis in his dreams
text:
The Floopa Loopa came way after the King of Rock and Roll, but that didn’t stop The Floopa Loopa from dreaming about him. Elvis is the Floopa Loopa’s hero. He wishes that he could have met him and so he dreamed that he met him and danced the Mango Tango with him.

 Do you have someone that is your hero? Someone you respect and love or someone that you look up to? While, you are coloring these pictures of the Floopa Loopa and his dreams of meeting Elvis, draw a picture of the person or persons that you look up to!

title: Different can be Good!
text:
The Floopa Loopa loves to be on stage! He is most confortable there! He loves the lights of Las Vegas and the big city. What a difference it is from Nigeria! There were no bright lights or big city, but the natives sure loved to watch him sing and dance!

 He was born different. That didn’t hold him back, though. He used his looks to his advantage! His colorful plumes became his signature look!

 If you were bom different, maybe with a speech impediment or a mental or a physical disorder, maybe a birthmark or a limp, or something that you think is disfiguring, use it to your advantage!

 Have you ever seen the super models with vitligo? They may look different, but they have used that to their advantage! What about the people who have Down Syndrome or Autism or maybe even a mental health disorder like depression? What about you? Were you born with something that you think of, as different? Use it to your advantage!

 You are smart! You are unique! You are a child of God! Whoever you are, you are special! Don’t let anyone tell you differently! Go out and shine and be the best you can be!

title: Meet Elvis!
text:
August 7,2026

 The Floopa Loopa is a real star, but where did he come from and what does he look like in real life?

 Do you know where the idea came for the Floopa Loopa?

 It was all rather inspired. I was at a church function for women and we were doing a watercolor project. I didn’t want to do the owl project they were doing, but just started painting, and came up with the Floopa Loopa. Truly divinely inspired!

 The Floopa Loopa is a Nigerian Pharaoh Owl or better known as an Eagle Owl. You can see the similarities with the Eagle Owl and the Floopa Loopa by the long legs, big yellow eyes, and the floof around his eyes.

 He came to the United States to become an Elvis Impersonator, because he had read about Elvis and loved his movies. He looked in the mirror and thought,”I want to be like him. I can sing and I can dance! Why can’t I be like him?”

 The Floopa Loopa loves Elvis so much, because 1) they look alike, 2) they have fun dance moves, and 3) they can sing.

 Do you know that the Floopa Loopa has his own dance moves? Yes, he does.

 Do you want to try them out? Here they are. If you want to shimmy and shake like the Floopa Loopa, let’s try them out.

 “He hops, then he flits, he’ll scoot and he’ll twitch, he hems and he haws, he coos, then he caws, he moves this way and that, he flaps, then he preens, he goes round and between, he claps, then he hoots, he falls, then he sploots, he goes round and round, then he crawls on thee ground. And that’s the Mango Tango!”

 See if you can do it too!

 See you soon! Keep on dancin

title: Introducing The Floopa Loopa
text:
Have you ever had a dream? Have you ever wanted something so bad that you thought about it day and night? Well, my friend, “The Floopa Loopa” had just such a dream. He dreamed of being like his hero:Elvis! He didn’t just want to look like Elvis! He didn’t just want to sing like Elvis! He wanted to be his hero, the King Of Rock and Roll!!!

 Let me take you on a journey with The Floopa Loopa as he follows his dream “along the path that Elvis took.” We’ll travel to Las Vegas, Hawaii, Memphis, and back to Las Vegas!

 Don’t forget his signature song and dance that will make you want to get up and dance, too!

 This book is an inspiration to all who have ever had a dream and decided to go for it.
